name: refunds-dashboard
description: Internal refunds review dashboard (React + Express + SQLite)

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run env:init
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "server,client" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
